connector.name: EasyAccessPDF
connector.registryDescription: PDF accessibility checks (veraPDF PDF/UA-1), auto-fix and Markdown conversion. EU-hosted.
connector.summary: Hosted at easyaccesspdf.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the luotwo account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: HTTP Basic token: base64(account-email:wordpress-application-password). Requires an EasyAccessPDF account; MCP Membership ($19.90/32 days) unlocks conversions, exports and checks; eap_fix_pdf bills 1 credit per document. Setup guide: https://easyaccesspdf.com/mcp/
